verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a sandbox with test accounts for simulating open banking connections, and client libraries in Java, Python, Node.js and more. Those libraries are generated by the developer from Yapily's OpenAPI spec rather than shipped as official SDKs. Authentication uses an Application ID and Secret, but nothing shows self-serve key issuance at signup or a runnable quickstart. Missing for 10: self-serve signup and API key provisioning, a runnable quickstart to first linked sandbox account, official prebuilt client libraries, hands-on time-to-first-call corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first linked sandbox account fast — self-serve API keys, a runnable quickstart, and client libraries in my language

citations.quote: A sandbox is a test environment that allows you to connect your application to a bank and access test accounts to simulate the real Open Banking experience.
Generate API client libraries for Yapily in your preferred language using the OpenAPI specification. Supports code generation for Java, Python, Node.js, and more.
The Yapily API uses **HTTP Basic Authentication**.
